description: This Java class 'ResourceLimits' defines resource limit configurations for a tenant in the Eclipse Hono project. It includes properties such as maximum connections, maximum TTL, data volume, and extension properties, along with methods for setting and retrieving these values.

classes.name: ResourceLimits
classes.description: Defines resource limits (connections, TTL, data volume, extensions) for a tenant, with fluent setters and getters, and validation for properties.

methods.name: setMaxConnections
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of connections, throws if less than -1.

methods.name: getMaxConnections
methods.description: Returns the max connections or the default unlimited constant.

methods.name: setMaxTtl
methods.description: Sets the maximum TTL, throws if less than -1.

methods.name: getDataVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the DataVolume object associated with resource limits.

methods.name: putExtension
methods.description: Adds or replaces an extension key-value pair; initializes extensions map if null.
